Timestamps instants, exactly ts_type = "integer64". Counts, flags sequence numbers exactly. Text exactly, normalising empty field. title: Equivalence with the official Python client
text: Five, documented rather papered . Index versus column. to_df() returns frame indexed ts_recv (ts_event OHLCV). tibble index, databentoR keeps field first column, CSV encoding puts anyway. Empty text fields "" pandas NA R. Timestamp resolution. POSIXct double count seconds, modern dates resolves quarter microsecond. Use ts_type = "integer64" nanoseconds matter. Unsigned 64-bit fields. R unsigned integer type. order_id raw_instrument_id exact 2^53; venue observed far comes close exceeding . pretty_ts collapses two cases. CSV encoder writes empty field undefined timestamp literal zero, to_df() distinguishes . ts_type = "integer64" requests raw timestamps keeps distinction.

text: dataset Dataset code, e.g. "GLBX.MDP3". symbols Character vector symbols, single comma-separated string, NULL symbols. stype_in = "instrument_id" numeric vector accepted. 2000 symbols per request. schema Schema name, see db_schemas(). start, end Request window, start inclusive end exclusive. string passes verbatim, Date becomes plain date, POSIXct ISO-8601 UTC instant, number read nanoseconds since UNIX epoch. Leaving end NULL asks server forward-fill start. encoding Output encoding, see db_encodings(). compression Output compression, see db_compressions(). pretty_px Write decimal prices instead fixed-point integers. pretty_ts Write ISO-8601 timestamps instead nanosecond counts. map_symbols Append symbol field every record. NULL, default, means TRUE text encodings FALSE DBN. split_symbols Split output one file per symbol. split_duration Split output "day", "week", "month", "year" "none". split_size Optional maximum size per output file, bytes. delivery Delivery mechanism; "download" one offered. stype_in Symbol type symbols, see db_stypes(). Use "parent" product-level symbols "ES.FUT" "SPX.OPT". stype_out Symbol type output, see db_stypes(). limit Optional cap number records.

title: Download a historical range as a tibble — db_get_range
text: dataset Dataset code, e.g. "GLBX.MDP3". start, end Request window, start inclusive end exclusive. string passes verbatim, Date becomes plain date, POSIXct ISO-8601 UTC instant, number read nanoseconds since UNIX epoch. Leaving end NULL asks server forward-fill start. symbols Character vector symbols, single comma-separated string, NULL symbols. stype_in = "instrument_id" numeric vector accepted. 2000 symbols per request. schema Schema name, see db_schemas(). stype_in Symbol type symbols, see db_stypes(). Use "parent" product-level symbols "ES.FUT" "SPX.OPT". stype_out Symbol type output, see db_stypes(). API resolves "instrument_id" every input type, "raw_symbol" "instrument_id". limit Optional cap number records. path Optional file path. given, result also written parquet, tibble returned invisibly. pretty_px Ask server decimal prices instead fixed-point integers scaled 1e-9. pretty_ts Ask server ISO-8601 timestamps instead nanosecond counts. FALSE timestamp columns come back character, nanosecond count fit R numeric type without loss. map_symbols Ask server append symbol column every record. ts_type timestamps represented R. "POSIXct", default, convenient stores seconds double, modern dates resolves roughly quarter microsecond rather nanosecond. "integer64" keeps exact nanosecond count (requires bit64 package forces pretty_ts = FALSE), want book reconstruction latency work. compression Transfer compression, "none" "zstd". "zstd" worth large pulls decompressed transparently. col_types Optional arrow schema overriding column types databentoR assign.

title: databentoR 0.1.0
text: Column types assigned field name, never inferred. arrow’s CSV inference reads trades slice whose action column "T" boolean, silently corrupt every trade action. db_field_types() reports assigned. ts_type = "integer64" returns exact nanosecond timestamps. default POSIXct stores seconds double resolves quarter microsecond modern dates. Symbols normalised Python client normalises : upper-cased, roll rule continuous symbol lower-cased, NULL becoming ALL_SYMBOLS, documented 2000-symbol cap enforced request spent. Date parameters reject timestamps, Python client, rather silently truncating instant day. HTTP 206 raises warning: success code means symbols resolved. X-Warning response header surfaced R warning, server-side deprecation notices swallowed.

title: databentoR 0.1.0
text: Wire equivalence pinned Python client 28 endpoints, offline free, asserting method, endpoint, parameter names, values order. R value domains checked compiled DBN enums. Data equivalence six tiny slices spanning ohlcv-1d, trades, tbbo, mbp-1, statistics definition, prices compared relative tolerance 1e-12. weekly workflow diffs new upstream release pin files changed calls issue. Downloaded market data never committed; reference fixtures stay untracked.
